Hi Sophie — sorry for the trouble and thanks for the clear reproduction steps + attachments.

Quick update on our side:
- I looked up your Coupa record and the system shows an "invited" state but no activation event.
- We sometimes see large procurement digesting mailers collapse the one-click URL into a summary and the click target gets rewritten by the customer's mail system.

Two options:
1) I can trigger a manual activation from our admin console (requires confirmation of the W9 & bank details). If you confirm the attached W9 is final I will activate the vendor and you can set the credentials.
2) We can resend an invite with an alternate subject + short-lived token so it won't be batched into your digest (subject line: "Action required: Redwood vendor activation for Polaris Foundry").

Ben — can you keep an eye on rate limits if we resend? Laura — can you please confirm from CS if manual activation will create any reconciliation issues with Coupa?

My ask to Polaris: please reply with final confirmation on W9 & preferred path (1 or 2). If path 1, we'll do the manual activation immediately.

Thanks,

Hi Sophie / Stephanie — quick confirmation: we manually activated Polaris Foundry vendor record at 14:00 PT.

What we did:
- Verified W9 received (attached original).
- Flipped vendor state to "active" in the admin console (this writes back a reconciliation note to Coupa via our integration).
- Sent an email to your procurement alias with temporary password instructions (separate email to avoid digest).

Sophie — you should be able to log in now at https://suppliers.redwoodinference.com/login (please try an incognito tab to avoid cached cookies). If you still see a 403, reply and we'll escalate to platform on-call.

HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1245789 (I added the activation timestamp and attached W9).
